head_end_offset.description: Byte offset of `head_end_seq` in the worklog.

head_end_seq.description: The head (opening input + first round) kept verbatim ahead of the summary: the worklog entries before `head_end_seq`. `0`: no head.

history_summary.description: Summary (llm_compress) of the history between the head and `start_seq`.

keep_exact.description: Strings kept verbatim next to the summary (`<keep_exact>`): appended by each compression, never rewritten by the summarizer.

start_offset.description: Byte offset of `start_seq` in the worklog: reverse reads stop here.

start_seq.description: First worklog seq used verbatim after the summary.
